description: qiniu_exporter overview: exporter health, Kodo, CDN and billing.

panels.title: Exporter · Health, Data Freshness, and API Rate Limiting

targets.expr: (clamp_min(time() - qiniu_exporter_data_timestamp_seconds{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}, 0) or on(qiniu_account, job, instance, module, collector) clamp_min(time() - qiniu_exporter_collector_last_success_timestamp_seconds{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}, 0)) / on(qiniu_account, job, instance, module, collector) qiniu_exporter_collector_stale_after_seconds{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}

(sum by (qiniu_account) (increase(qiniu_exporter_api_rate_limit_events_total{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__range])) and on(qiniu_account) max by (qiniu_account) (up{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} == 1)) or on(qiniu_account) (0 * max by (qiniu_account) (up{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} == 1))

panels.description: No data is expected until the selected exporter has made an upstream API attempt in the displayed time range.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (qiniu_account, service, host, le) (rate(qiniu_exporter_api_limiter_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Local Limiter Wait p95

panels.description: Persistent gate rows explain collectors intentionally disabled by validation or allowlist settings. A lone account-level zero means no active gates. Non-gate rows are scheduler skips added during the selected time range.

targets.expr: ((sum by (qiniu_account, module, collector, reason) (qiniu_exporter_scheduler_skipped_total{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",reason=~"timezone_unverified|units_unverified|allowlist_empty"}) > bool 0) and on(qiniu_account) max by (qiniu_account) (up{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} == 1)) or on(qiniu_account) (0 * max by (qiniu_account) (up{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} == 1))

panels.title: Collection Gates / Recent Scheduler Skips

panels.description: No data is expected when no upstream API request occurred in the displayed time range.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (qiniu_account, service, endpoint, le) (rate(qiniu_exporter_api_request_duration_seconds_bucket{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Qiniu API Duration p95

panels.description: No data is expected until statistics gates are enabled and discovered Kodo buckets or CDN domains have been collected.
panels.title: Configured Resource Health / Age
Kodo · Inventory and Object Storage Statistics

panels.description: All Kodo buckets discovered automatically through Qiniu's read-only bucket-list API. This inventory remains available while statistics collection is gated.
panels.title: Discovered Buckets

panels.description: Bucket metadata plus Qiniu usage statistics. Today's Storage and Today's Objects are the latest complete safe capacity point summed across the selected storage classes. Month Direct Egress and Month PUT Requests are natural-month-to-date gauges from Qiniu day buckets, not values reconstructed from Prometheus scrape history.

targets.expr: max by (qiniu_account, bucket, storage_region, region, access) (qiniu_kodo_bucket_info{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",bucket=~"${bucket:regex}",region=~"${kodo_region:regex}",storage_region!=""})

sum by (qiniu_account, bucket, region) (max by (qiniu_account, bucket, region, storage_class) (qiniu_kodo_storage_bytes{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",bucket=~"${bucket:regex}",region=~"${kodo_region:regex}",storage_class=~"${storage_class:regex}"}))

sum by (qiniu_account, bucket, region) (max by (qiniu_account, bucket, region, storage_class) (qiniu_kodo_objects{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",bucket=~"${bucket:regex}",region=~"${kodo_region:regex}",storage_class=~"${storage_class:regex}"}))

panels.title: Bucket Inventory

panels.description: No data is expected while the Kodo timezone validation gate is active. Confirm the gate state above before treating an empty panel as a collection failure.

panels.description: No data is expected while the Kodo timezone validation gate is active. Confirm the gate state above before treating an empty panel as a collection failure.

panels.description: Total CDN domains returned by Qiniu domain discovery. This inventory remains available while traffic-statistics validation gates are active.
panels.title: Discovered CDN Domains

panels.description: Domain counts grouped by Qiniu operatingState. This field reports the most recent domain-management operation state; it is not an availability probe.

targets.expr: count by (qiniu_account, operating_state) (max by (qiniu_account, domain, operating_state) (qiniu_cdn_domain_info{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",domain=~"${domain:regex}"}))

panels.title: Domains by Operating State

panels.description: Read-only CDN inventory discovered from Qiniu. operatingState is the last domain-management operation state, not an availability probe.
panels.title: CDN Domain Inventory

panels.description: Complete-scope traffic bytes in the last complete Asia/Shanghai clock hour. This all-domain account total intentionally ignores the domain selector and is unavailable when any active domain failed collection.
panels.title: All-Domain Hour Traffic

panels.description: Exact all-domain account peak in the last complete hour. The exporter sums domains at each aligned five-minute point before taking the maximum. This synchronized account value intentionally ignores the domain selector.
panels.title: All-Domain Hour Peak

panels.description: Complete-scope traffic accumulated today through the latest five-minute bucket. This all-domain account total intentionally ignores the domain selector. Color thresholds: yellow above 350 GiB and red above 750 GiB.
panels.title: All-Domain Today Traffic

panels.description: Exact account bandwidth peak today through the latest complete five-minute bucket. This account-wide synchronized peak intentionally does not follow the domain filter.
panels.title: All-Domain Today Peak

panels.description: Complete-scope current-month traffic combines completed billing-grade day buckets with today's complete five-minute monitoring buckets. This all-domain account total intentionally ignores the domain selector.
panels.title: All-Domain Month Traffic

panels.description: Exact all-domain current-month peak from billing-grade five-minute bandwidth points for completed days plus today's complete monitoring points. Completed days are cached. This synchronized account value intentionally ignores the domain selector.
panels.title: All-Domain Month Peak

panels.description: Complete-scope count of active domains with non-zero traffic today. Unlike operatingState=success, this is observed usage. It intentionally ignores the domain selector and is unavailable for an incomplete collection.
panels.title: Active Domains Today

panels.description: Total CDN domains visible to the configured Qiniu credentials. This inventory count includes domains in every operating state.
panels.title: CDN Domains

panels.description: All-domain traffic for each Asia/Shanghai date in the current month. Completed dates use Qiniu billing-grade day buckets; today includes data through the latest complete five-minute monitoring bucket. Color thresholds: yellow above 350 GiB and red above 750 GiB.
panels.title: Current Month Daily All-Domain Traffic

panels.description: Latest complete five-minute bandwidth, summed across the selected domain scope and split by Qiniu region. Select one domain for its own series. No data is expected while CDN timezone or monitoring-unit validation is gated.

targets.expr: sum by (qiniu_account, region) (max by (qiniu_account, domain, region) (qiniu_cdn_monitoring_bandwidth_bits_per_second{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",domain=~"${domain:regex}",region=~"${cdn_region:regex}"}))

panels.title: Monitoring Bandwidth

panels.description: Latest complete five-minute traffic rate, summed across the selected domain scope and split by Qiniu region. Select one domain for its own series. No data is expected while CDN timezone or monitoring-unit validation is gated.

targets.expr: sum by (qiniu_account, region) (max by (qiniu_account, domain, region) (qiniu_cdn_monitoring_traffic_bytes_per_second{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",domain=~"${domain:regex}",region=~"${cdn_region:regex}"}))

panels.title: Monitoring Traffic Rate

panels.description: The five selected domains with the most current-month traffic. Values combine completed metering days with today's complete monitoring buckets; inactive domains remain zero.

targets.expr: (topk(5, max by (qiniu_account, domain) (qiniu_cdn_usage_traffic_bytes{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",domain=~"${domain:regex}",period="current_month"})) and on (qiniu_account) (max by (qiniu_account) (qiniu_cdn_usage_complete{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",period="current_month"}) == 1)) / 1073741824

panels.title: Current Month Traffic · Top 5 Domains

panels.description: Exact current-month five-minute peak bandwidth for the same five domains selected by current-month traffic. Completed billing-grade days are cached and merged with today's complete monitoring points.

targets.expr: (max by (qiniu_account, domain) (qiniu_cdn_usage_peak_bandwidth_bits_per_second{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",domain=~"${domain:regex}",period="current_month"}) and on (qiniu_account, domain) topk(5, max by (qiniu_account, domain) (qiniu_cdn_usage_traffic_bytes{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",domain=~"${domain:regex}",period="current_month"}))) and on (qiniu_account) (max by (qiniu_account) (qiniu_cdn_usage_complete{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",period="current_month"}) == 1)

panels.title: Month Traffic Top 5 · Peak Bandwidth

Billing · Balance, Costs, and Resource Packs

panels.description: Latest available account balance returned by Qiniu. Unavailable remains distinct from zero; no account-specific low-balance threshold is assumed.
panels.title: Available Balance

panels.description: Latest unpaid amount returned by Qiniu. Zero is green; an amount of 0.01 or more is orange. Unavailable remains distinct from zero.
panels.title: Unpaid Amount

panels.description: Estimated cost for Qiniu's current billing period. This is not a finalized invoice and may change during the period.
panels.title: Current Estimate

panels.description: Most recently available finalized monthly cost returned by Qiniu. Use the monthly panel below for the rolling 12-month history.
panels.title: Last Finalized Month

panels.description: The latest twelve finalized Asia/Shanghai billing months, including the previous calendar year when applicable. Month labels use YYYY-MM.
panels.title: Last 12 Months Finalized Cost

panels.description: Estimated values are next-day increments derived from adjacent cumulative snapshots. Finalized values come only from one-day items in the v2 finalized bill; monthly-billed items are not artificially distributed across days. Compact labels use MM-DD so the date remains visible.
panels.title: Daily Costs · Estimated and Finalized

panels.description: No data is expected when the resource-pack allowlist is empty. Use Resource Pack Status / Records below to distinguish disabled collection from an enabled empty result.

panels.title: Resource Pack Quantities (do not sum across unit)

panels.description: Disabled means the allowlist is empty. Enabled with zero records is a valid complete response. No value means collection has not succeeded or is unavailable.
